state.back_rename: Edition E completed X to Y. X remains reserved for E under old token A solely because the release has not run. E starts a new Y to X rename under token B. The design says the new rename remains pending while A is released, then X is reserved using B.
state.cancel: E creation operation T is pending. A durable E cancellation event commits at version 5. A paused creation-complete worker previously read version 4 and then attempts to append at version 4. All writers use expected-position append.
state.confirm: E creation T was durably cancelled. Its matching claim later confirms based on an earlier committed label acceptance. The delayed completion handler reloads the E stream and requires T still be pending and uncancelled.
state.publish_refused: E recorded publication attempt P, and rename is blocked while P is pending. P then records a durable refusal on E. E remains a draft with the same confirmed label and no other pending operation.
state.scoped: Operation identity is the pair (edition ID, operation ID). Edition E1 uses token T for label alpha. Another edition E2 uses the same raw token T for label beta.
state.source: The current implementation has a fixed platform catalog with a fixed edition ID. It has no CriteriaEditionDrafted source event.

back_needs_old.instructions: In back_rename, should operation B reuse token A as its reservation generation?

back_pending.instructions: In back_rename, can E retry its new rename while old-token cleanup is pending?

stale_commit.instructions: In cancel, can the paused append at the old expected version commit after the cancellation?

confirm_activates.instructions: In confirm, does the delayed confirmation allow the edition to become a usable draft?

refusal_allows_rename.instructions: In publish_refused, is a later rename excluded merely because P was once attempted?

scoped_collision.instructions: In scoped, are E1/T and E2/T the same operation identity?

seed_event_exists.instructions: In source, is a CriteriaEditionDrafted event already present in the current implementation?
